ambient_events: The door chime goes, then goes again forty seconds later on the way out.
A crate of something is dragged out onto the pavement and squared up with a boot.
Somebody reads the small ads taped inside the window all the way to the bottom, then leaves.
description: A corner shop with a shopfront of adverts, layered so deep that the actual window is down to a letterbox of clear glass at head height. Crates of whatever is going sit out on the pavement under an awning that winds down with a handle. It opens at six and it is not clear that it ever entirely closes.
name: Corner the Market
